description: This file defines a React functional component called RouterSettings used for configuring routing-related settings within a web application's UI. It includes state management, side effects, and interaction with external API calls for fetching and updating router configurations, as well as rendering various sub-components for setting routing strategies and related parameters.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Handles the saving process for router settings, including parsing input fields, constructing payload, and calling API to update settings, along with user notifications.
